revisions.reason: 20261120 explicit GPS preparation: capture actual guest/link/instance/memory/process/renderer/thread owners at an ordinary scheduler boundary; hold writer admission through synchronous observer installation, validate participants across awaits, then resume only the same captured continuation. Actual GPS factory waits for render writer/journal installation before returning the real port; errors terminate that newly owned port. PREPARED has no publication join. Stop/reinit and guest retirement synchronously invalidate the epoch and retire both joins, remove owned error/retirement listeners, clear the finite preparation timer and settle cleanup outcomes. Native source/publication checks remain unchanged; no guest EIP, input, frame, callback or clock writes. Lifecycle9 and existing manager32 cancellation/replacement/stop/failure controls pass; native GPS/source qualification is separate. General callback ownership remains pending.
